title: Correcting an invalid number clears the error at once
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Click the Day box.
  3. Type 0 in the Day box.
  4. Replace the 0 with 25, without leaving the box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • "Due day of the following month" is chosen.

Step 3:

  • The message "Enter a day from 1 to 31." shows.

Step 4:

  • The message disappears immediately, while the cursor is still in the Day box.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
